title: GodScar Dev Update: Character Creator
author: irbrandonl
selftext:
Hey everyone! Back with another development update for GODSCAR, my dark fantasy turn based RPG.

Today I wanted to show off an early look at the game's character creator, which is still very much a work in progress...

One of my biggest goals with GodScar is to give players the freedom to create a character that truly feels like their own, not just in appearance, but in how they experience the world and its story.

There are still quite a few things I want to improve. For starters, I want to make the character sprites in the menus more detailed and defined, refine the facial customization so changes are more noticeable and precise, and polish some of the sprite animations. There are also plenty of smaller visual and UI improvements I still plan to make.

Something I'm particularly excited about is the background system. I'm currently developing four playable backgrounds for the demo, each with its own unique opening story, characters, experiences, and choices that can influence how your journey unfolds. I really want your character's past to matter beyond just a few dialogue options.

There are plenty more backgrounds planned for the full game, but for now, I'm focusing on getting these four polished and ready for the demo.

It's still early, but I'm excited about where things are heading, and I wanted to share another glimpse of the development process with you all!

As always, I'd love to hear your thoughts! Whether it's the customization options, UI, animations, or anything else you notice, constructive criticism and suggestions are always appreciated.

Developed with Claude Opus 5.5 (Extra Effort)
